authorization:
사용자 원문: 그래 한 50개 만들고 전부 통과시켜
신규50종의 기술/독립 시각 검수 통과를 위해 지적 좌표를 실제로 교정하고, 이후 사용자 위임으로 Allow한다. 검수 결과를 꾸미지 않고 기존 판정을 보존한다.

issues.message: The narrow muzzle and cheek read almost entirely in profile; the torso also has little visible front-facing shoulder plane. Add a small distinct muzzle end plane and a 2-3 pixel near-cheek/shoulder depth plane, with consistent near/far limb overlap, to establish the requested front-and-side 3/4 view. Carry that anatomy through the other poses.

The horn still slopes upward above the snout while the legs make a broad running stride, weakening the intended horn-first ram at the contact pose. Lower the head/horn aim by several native pixels and show a compressed neck-to-shoulder thrust so the horn tip clearly leads the forward impact. Preserve its connected root and the planted support hoof.

The large effect is attached at the horn tip, but the downward/right zigzag is an unbranched ribbon; only the upper stroke has clear forks. Add a substantial diverging fork to the lower bolt around this bend and separate the two bolt paths visually at their shared horn origin. Retain continuous gold-white pixels from the real horn tip.

The low neck and compressed four-leg stance are too similar to poison; stars provide most of the state distinction. Redraw the front support with a visible stagger or knee buckle and a different drooping head angle, then vary that imbalance in stun_b. Keep a supporting hoof on the shared ground line so the pair reads as dazed instability rather than another poison crouch.
